newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Park unit files for reorganization. [CORRECTED 13:01 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Park unit files for reorganization. [CORRECTED 13:01 GMT]

text.p: Hollywood Park Inc said Wednesday that its subsidiary Sunflower Racing Inc, which owns and operates the Woodlands Race Track in Kansas City, Kansas, filed a plan of reorganization in bankruptcy court.
(Deletes reference to Chapter 11, as unit had applied for reorganization under Chapter 11 in May 1996. Clarifies that it is now filing a plan of reorganization).

The company said the reorganization plan contemplates the sale of Sunflower's property to the Wyandotte Indians of Oklahoma. It said that the Wyandottes would place the land in trust and plan to build a casino on the site. Hollywood Park and a partner company, North America Sports Management Inc of Florida, would then manage the casino in return for 30 percent of the profit, the company said.

It said it wrote off its investment in Sunflower in March 1996, taking a one-time, non-cash loss for the investment, and has not included the results of Sunflower's operations in its consolidated financial statements since then.
